title: 流沙

sections.evidence: Page 1 Systems 0-1 (mm 0-8). Printed margin label '前奏'. Pickup bar m0 ('弱起 561') followed by 8 bars instrumental intro. 9 bars total.
Page 1 Systems 2-3 (mm 9-16). Printed margin label '主歌'. Verse 1: '并不是真的 路过而已 也不是真的 不会想你 全都不是真的 是骗自己 其实还爱你 爱着你'. 8 bars.
Page 1 Systems 4-5 (mm 17-23). Printed margin label '桥段'. Pickup bar m17 ('弱起 01') + 6 bars: '我以为我早想清楚 不由自主恍恍惚惚又走回头路 再看一眼有过的幸福'. 7 bars total.
Page 1 Systems 6-7 (mm 24-31). Printed margin label '副歌'. Chorus 1: '爱情好像流沙 我不挣扎 随它去吧 我不怕 爱情好像流沙 心里的牵挂 不愿放下 oh baby 让我这样吧'. 8 bars.
Page 1 System 8 (mm 32-35). Printed margin label '间奏'. 4-bar piano instrumental interlude.
Page 1 Systems 9-10 (mm 36-41). Printed margin label '变奏'. Bridge variation: 'NO NO NO NO是一再的做 一再的错 不由我 我一步一步一步一步 慢慢走向流沙'. 6 bars.
Page 1 Systems 11-12 (mm 42-46). Printed margin label '尾奏'. 4-bar piano outro plus final held bar m46 ('1 - - -'). 5 bars total.
Page 2 Systems 13-14 (mm 47-54). Printed margin label '主歌' on chord-only 弹唱版. 8 bars.
Page 2 Systems 15-16 (mm 55-60). Printed margin label '桥段' on chord-only 弹唱版. 6 bars.
Page 2 Systems 17-18 (mm 61-68). Printed margin label '副歌' on chord-only 弹唱版. 8 bars.
Page 2 System 19 (m 69). Final resolution bar on chord 1.

uncertain: Page 2 is a separate 弹唱版 (chord-only arrangement). Annotations include both pages mapped to global measure indices 0-69.
Section C1 (mm 17-23) is labeled '桥段' (bridge) in the score, though structurally functioning as a prechorus to the chorus.
notes: Page 1 (mm 0-46) is 专业版; Page 2 (mm 47-69) is 弹唱版. Section labels are printed explicitly in score margins.
